# AI Test Workbench (`ai-test-workbench` / `aitw` v5.1.0)

> Trustworthy Verification Kernel & AI-Agent-First multi-protocol MCP Server (`stdio`, Streamable HTTP `/mcp`, Legacy HTTP+SSE `/sse`) for Playwright E2E/API verification. Supports Chinese-default docs with paired English `.en.md` docs.

## Core v5.0 Capabilities
- **4-Layer Anti-Fake-Green Gate Kernel (`templates/playwright-qa/support/gate-kernel.mjs`, `src/governance.mjs`, `src/ledger.mjs`)**: Combines SHA-256 `.aitest/governance.lock` tamper protection, `tsc` + `eslint-plugin-playwright`, ULID `Run Ledger` input-hash binding + human-approved `waivers.json`, and an `S0–S5` Semantic Assertion Strength Lattice Diff Guard (`FGER = 0.0%`, `26/26` cheating patches blocked).
- **Native Multi-Protocol MCP Server v2 & Job Runner (`src/mcp-server.mjs`, `src/jobs.mjs`)**: Zero runtime npm dependencies; supports MCP `2025-11-25`..`2024-11-05` with **21 typed tools**, isolated child-process jobs (`syncBudgetMs`), `_meta.progressToken` heartbeats, `notifications/cancelled` process-tree termination, concurrent read tools, and per-workspace write locks.
- **One-Call Change Verdict & Stateful Healer (`src/verdict.mjs`, `src/heal.mjs`, `src/traceability.mjs`)**: `aitest_verify_change` emits `attestation.json`, `verdict-summary.md`, and `verdict.sarif.json`; `aitest_heal_begin|attempt|conclude` hard-blocks Class B/C/D test edits (`0.0%` mis-heal rate) and maps `REQ-xxx` traceability.
- **Import-Graph Impact v2 & Living Code Map v4 (`src/impact.mjs`, `src/codemap.mjs`, `src/explore.mjs`)**: Static reverse `import` dependency graph with `why` provenance, default-deny read-only exploration (`specs/pages/*.md`), preserved `:id`/`[id]` dynamic routes, and automatic defect convergence.
- **PerformanceObserver Web Vitals, WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 & JSON Schema Contracts (`src/perf.mjs`, `base.ts`, `schema-validator.mjs`)**: Real `LCP / CLS / INP` median & P75 capture, guarded `page.request` + `context.request` + allowlist egress, active W3C `traceparent` correlation, and `100%` seeded-defect detection (`7/7`).
